**Computation site:** `RebuildMemoPayload` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74-88` — which calls `markdownService.ExtractAll(memo.Content)`, implemented at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:355-417` (`(*service).ExtractAll`, via a single goldmark AST walk), and writes the results into `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property`.

**Triggers (recomputation):**
- `CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` (every new memo)
- `UpdateMemo`, but only when the update mask includes the `content` path — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447` (i.e., recomputed only if the memo's content actually changed, not on other field-only updates like visibility or pinned)

**Extracted properties** (from `ExtractedData`/`storepb.MemoPayload_Property`, `internal/markdown/markdown.go:21-25` and the walk logic at markdown.go:369-410):
- `Tags` — all `#tag` occurrences (deduplicated, case-preserved)
- `Property.Title` — text of a leading H1 heading, if the document's first top-level block is one
- `Property.HasLink` — whether any link node is present
- `Property.HasCode` — whether any code block/fenced code block/code span is present
- `Property.HasTaskList` — whether any task checkbox is present
- `Property.HasIncompleteTasks` — whether any unchecked task checkbox is present

(`Mentions` is also extracted by `ExtractAll` but is not stored into `memo.Payload` by `RebuildMemoPayload` — it's used elsewhere for mention notifications, not as memo-list/preview metadata.)
